title: Uber Tempe developmental ADS crash
system_purpose: Developmental ADS test vehicle operation on public roads
decision_impact: Vehicle control while a safety operator occupied the driver's seat
affected_groups: Pedestrian; safety operator; other road users
verified_facts: NTSB reported that an ADS-controlled test vehicle struck and fatally injured a pedestrian in Tempe and identified distracted operator monitoring plus inadequate safety-risk assessment and oversight as contributing factors.
reported_harm: A pedestrian died; the report also identifies foreseeable automation-complacency and governance harms for road users.
quantitative_evidence: The report records a 49-year-old pedestrian death and says the vehicle had been operating about 19 minutes in autonomous mode.
limitations: A single investigated crash cannot quantify the risk of a different system, route, sensor suite, or operating policy.

title: NHTSA Tesla Autopilot recall-query investigation
system_purpose: Partial driving automation with driver controls and engagement features
decision_impact: Driver engagement and vehicle-control supervision during automated operation
affected_groups: Drivers; vehicle occupants; pedestrians; other road users
verified_facts: NHTSA's recall-query opening document states that its earlier investigation identified at least 13 fatal crashes and many serious-injury crashes in which foreseeable driver misuse appeared to play a role, and it questioned remedy effectiveness.
reported_harm: The document describes serious injury and fatal crash risk associated with apparent foreseeable misuse; it does not assign every crash to one cause.
quantitative_evidence: NHTSA stated at least 13 crashes involved one or more fatalities in its earlier investigation.
limitations: The inquiry was open and the document does not determine fault for each crash or evaluate SafeRoute.

title: California suspension of Cruise permits
system_purpose: Driverless deployment and driverless testing of autonomous vehicles
decision_impact: Permission to operate autonomous vehicles on public roads
verified_facts: California DMV immediately suspended Cruise deployment and driverless testing permits and stated the department found the vehicles not safe for public operation under the cited regulations.
reported_harm: The regulator action shows public-safety and safety-information governance harm can stop operations, even where a technical root cause is not fully established in the statement.
quantitative_evidence: The suspension was effective immediately on 2023-10-24.
limitations: The public statement and enforcement record do not substitute for a complete causal analysis of each incident.
